title: BLS [RP]
description: The Custom Texture Pack for Buttershea's "Butterless Lifesteal"
body:
This is the Offical Resource Pack [RP] for the "Butterless Lifesteal" Server Plugin. This pack is made for all version of 1.21+ for anybody to use freely

If you have any problems with the pack join my discord and either I or someone else will gladly help you with fixing the problem

Discord Server: https://discord.gg/drR5XgHRWB

[RP's] Server Plugin: https://modrinth.com/plugin/butterless-lifesteal
